zero_reference_assembly_bounds.note: Native STEP BREP body bounds in q=0 construction reference, includes canonical one jaw; excludes procedural springs, flexible cables, bench and payload. Not an asserted operating pose.

limitations: Native fit checks are nominal geometry checks, not tolerance-stack approval or manufacturing release.
Catalog motor/reducer/brake geometry remains a full-size outer envelope with catalog mass; vendor internals and true inertia distribution are unverified.
Belt tooth section is an explicit rounded nominal approximation; cutter geometry, pretension, alignment and endurance require supplier qualification.
Continuous-proxy task-path collision evidence is separate; no claim that all combinations of hard joint limits are collision-free.
Flexible spring and cable collision, fastener preload, structural stress and thermal life are not qualified.
